comparison.angles: compare Karto-dumped normalized radians directly; no posthoc wrap/alignment
comparison.covariance: all 3x3 elements in edge insertion order
comparison.high_precision: max_digits10 graph JSON; any nonzero numerical difference leads REVIEW if 6dp exact
comparison.numeric_6dp: %.6f round-trip per float, then exact elementwise comparison
comparison.structure: exact node IDs, unique IDs, edge endpoints and insertion order

gate_rule.BUILD_ISOLATION_FAILED: runtime binary/library source or false mode unverified
gate_rule.SERIAL_KARTO_NUMERICAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: 24/24 valid and 6dp exact but high-precision differs
gate_rule.SERIAL_KARTO_SCREENING_FAIL: any valid structural or 6dp numerical divergence
gate_rule.SERIAL_KARTO_SCREENING_PASS: 24/24 valid, all same-history pairs structure/6dp/high-precision exact
gate_rule.SERIAL_KARTO_TECHNICALLY_INCOMPLETE: missing/failed run or unavailable required evidence

mode_B: branch-style prefix gate against new serial reference; same strict six-decimal semantics, no combined stream or suffix
reference_rule: Each history session1/P/repeat1 is its sole new serial reference; reference cannot be replaced after failure
stop_rule: Stop immediately on missing/changed frozen input, binary/library SHA mismatch, reference run technical failure, crashed/partial run, callback/count/barrier failure, or provenance absence. Do not rerun failed slot. Continue all planned slots after a valid numerical mismatch to characterize clusters.
